outcome: Bleeding degree (Delta hemoglobin/hematocrit, hemoglobin and hematocrit % change indices)
cohort: Pregnant individuals with inherited factor deficiencies compared to a control group without such deficiencies.
finding: The factor deficiency group exhibited increased delta hemoglobin/hematocrit values and percentage changes, indicative of greater bleeding, along with lower gestational age at birth and APGAR scores compared to the control group, suggesting these new delta bleeding indices are promising for objective bleeding identification.
